<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>EX-3.1</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 3.1 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">LIMITED PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">OF
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">HARBOURVEST PRIVATE EQUITY SECONDARIES FUND (TE) L.P. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Limited Partnership Agreement of HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund (TE) L.P., is entered into by and between HarbourVest GP
LLC, as general partner (the &#8220;<U>General Partner</U>&#8221;), and Mary Traer, as limited partner (the &#8220;<U>Initial Limited</U> <U>Partner</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The General Partner and the Initial Limited Partner hereby agree to form a limited partnership, pursuant to and in accordance with the
Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act (6 <I>Del. C</I>. section <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17-101,</FONT> <I>et seq</I>.) (as amended, the &#8220;<U>Act</U>&#8221;), and agree to carry on the limited partnership subject to the terms
of this Agreement and in accordance with the provisions of the Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Name</U>. The name of the limited partnership shall be
HarbourVest Private Equity Secondaries Fund (TE) L.P. (the &#8220;<U>Partnership</U>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Offices; Registered Agent</U>. The
address of the registered office of the Partnership in the State of Delaware is c/o The Corporation Trust Company, Corporation Trust Center, 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, New Castle County, Delaware 19801. The name of the registered agent for
service of process on the Partnership at such address is The Corporation Trust Company. The Partnership may from time to time have such other place or places of business within or without the State of Delaware as the General Partner may determine.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Purpose</U>. The Partnership is organized for the purpose of making, holding and disposing of investments in securities and to
engage in any and all activities ancillary, convenient, or incidental to the foregoing as the General Partner shall deem necessary or advisable. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. <U>Partners</U>. The names and the business, residence or mailing addresses of the General Partner and the Initial Limited Partner are as
follows: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>General Partner</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">HarbourVest GP LLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">c/o
HarbourVest Partners, LLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">One Lincoln Street, Suite 1700 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Boston, Massachusetts 02111 </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>Initial Limited Partner</U> </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Mary Traer </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">c/o HarbourVest
Partners, LLC </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">One Lincoln Street, Suite 1700 </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Boston, Massachusetts 02111 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5.
<U>Powers</U>. The powers of the General Partner include all powers, statutory and otherwise, possessed by general partners under the laws of the State of Delaware. The General Partner, acting on behalf of the Partnership, shall be empowered to do
or cause to be done any and all acts deemed by the General Partner, in its sole judgment, to be necessary or advisable in furtherance of the purposes of the Partnership. Notwithstanding any other provisions of this Agreement, the General Partner is
authorized to execute and deliver any document on behalf of the Partnership without any vote or consent of any other partner. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6.
<U>Dissolution</U>. The Partnership shall dissolve, and its affairs shall be wound up upon the first to occur of the following: (<I>a</I>)&nbsp;December&nbsp;31, 2036, (<I>b</I>) the General Partner approves the dissolution in writing,
(<I>c</I>)&nbsp;an event of withdrawal of the General Partner has occurred under the Act, unless the business of the Partnership is continued in accordance with the Act, (<I>d</I>)&nbsp;an entry of a decree of judicial dissolution of the Partnership
has occurred under section <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">17-802</FONT> of the Act, or (<I>e</I>)&nbsp;at any time there are no limited partners of the Partnership unless the business of the Partnership is continued in accordance with the Act.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7. <U>Capital Contributions</U>. The General Partner and the Initial Limited Partner hereby each agree to contribute $1.00 capital
contribution to the Partnership when called upon to do so by the General Partner and shall contribute additional amounts as agreed between them in writing from time to time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8. <U>Additional Contributions</U>. No partner of the Partnership is required to make any additional capital contribution to the Partnership.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9. <U>Allocations of Profit and Losses</U>. The Partnership&#8217;s profits and losses shall be allocated in proportion to the capital
contributions of the partners of the Partnership. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">10. <U>Distributions</U>. At the time or times determined by the General Partner, the
General Partner shall cause the Partnership to distribute any cash held by it which is not reasonably necessary for the operation of the Partnership. Cash available for distribution shall be distributed to the partners of the Partnership in the same
proportion as their then capital account balances. Notwithstanding any provision to the contrary contained in this Agreement, the Partnership shall not make a distribution to a partner of the Partnership on account of such partner&#8217;s interest
in the Partnership if such distribution would violate the Act or other applicable law. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">11. <U>Transfer of Interests</U>. Any partner may transfer all or any part of his, her or
its interest in the Partnership only with the consent of the General Partner. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">12. <U>Withdrawal</U>. No partner may withdraw from the
Partnership except pursuant to an amendment to this Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">13. <U>Amendments; Additional Partners</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) Without the approval of the Initial Limited Partner or any other partner, the General Partner may amend, and may amend and restate, this
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Without the approval of the Initial Limited Partner, the General Partner may admit additional limited partners to the
Partnership. Upon the admission of additional limited partners to the Partnership, the Initial Limited Partner shall withdraw from the Partnership and shall be entitled to receive forthwith the return of her capital contribution, without interest or
deduction. After the admission of any additional limited partners pursuant to this Section&nbsp;13, the business of the Partnership shall continue as a limited partnership under the Act. The admission of additional limited partners to the
Partnership pursuant to this Section&nbsp;13&nbsp;may be accomplished by the amendment, or the amendment and restatement, of this Agreement, without the consent of the Initial Limited Partner being required. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">14. <U>Fiscal Year</U>. The fiscal year of the Partnership shall end on the 31st day of December in each year. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">15. <U>Governing Law</U>. THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE INTERPRETED AND ENFORCED IN ACCORDANCE WITH AND GOVERNED BY THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF DELAWARE
APPLICABLE TO AGREEMENTS MADE AND TO BE PERFORMED WHOLLY WITHIN THAT JURISDICTION. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">16. <U>Waiver of Partition</U>. Each of the partners
hereby irrevocably waives any and all rights that it may have to maintain any action for partition of any of the Partnership&#8217;s property. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">17. <U>Liability of Initial Limited Partner</U>. The Initial Limited Partner shall not have any liability for the obligations or liabilities of
the Partnership except to the extent required by the Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">18. <U>Counterparts</U>. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of
which shall be deemed an original, but all of which shall constitute one and the same instrument. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned, intending to be bound hereby, have duly executed this
Limited Partnership Agreement as of the 17<SUP STYLE="font-size:75%; vertical-align:top">th</SUP> day of February, 2026. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV ALIGN="right">
